summary: On PostgreSQL 18+, invalidate the server-prepared statement cache when the server reports a search_path change via ParameterStatus (GUC_REPORT), and skip the SET/RESET command-tag scan once search_path is reported.

tests.evidence: Behavior change on PG18+; SchemaTest adds searchPathPreparedStatementInPlpgsqlInvalidatesOnGucReport covering both pre-18 failure and 18+ re-prepare, and existing SET/RESET tests now run through the report path. Mandated, no concrete gap.

user_docs.evidence: server-prepare.md is rewritten to say PG18 'detects them wherever they happen and re-prepares automatically'; sehrope showed the $user + SET ROLE case where search_path text is unchanged, and the author agreed to tighten the wording and add a note about the limitation.

doc_comments.evidence: Non-obvious logic in receiveParameterStatus/processResults comes with accurate comments; test Javadocs updated consistently.

change_description.evidence: User-visible behavior change with no CHANGELOG.md entry under the open 42.7.12 section (the entry was added later in the release-notes PR #4270).

performance.evidence: receiveParameterStatus adds a string compare per search_path report and the SET scan is skipped on 18+; cheap, no measurement owed.

security.evidence: No auth, TLS, or untrusted-input parsing change; search_path value only compared.

backward_compat.evidence: PG17 and older keep the command-tag scan unchanged; on 18+ invalidation becomes value-based, which only adds invalidations (and skips none that changed the value).

concurrency.evidence: deallocateEpoch is bumped on the protocol-reading thread like the existing scan; no new shared state.

error_model.evidence: No error path added or changed.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial protocol-driven invalidation; sehrope's review exposed that '"$user", public' plus SET ROLE changes resolution without a search_path value change, so the stale-plan error still occurs (pre-existing, but now claimed covered).

user_value.evidence: Fixes the real 'cached plan must not change result type' after hidden search_path changes on PG18; no new option.

surprising_behavior.evidence: On 18+ changes inside PL/pgSQL now invalidate the cache; the user-visible effect is fewer errors, not surprises.

contradictions.evidence: Docs claim versus the $user limitation is counted under user_docs; code comments, tests, and description agree.

observability.evidence: Cache invalidation is silent as before; no new failure or fallback.

spec_conformance.evidence: Relies on PostgreSQL 18 marking search_path GUC_REPORT and on ParameterStatus semantics; the use is correct and version-gated by the presence of the parameter.

plan.why: Small, cohesive change to one invalidation path; one reviewer can cover correctness, docs claims, and tests together.
